notes.title: Tales From The Unending Void: Season 1: Bugfix (v0.12.9)
notes.content:
Tales From The Unending Void now supports Lovense. So if you have a device, you can link it up with the game and get yourself stimulated with tailored patterns for your toy of choice. 

I have good news for you if you don't own a Lovense device, or if you're in the market for another toy. To celebrate the launch of this update, I've partnered up with Lovense and we're able to offer you a whopping 55% discount on any purchase made using [url=https://www.lovense.com/a/PerverteerGames]this affiliate link[/url].

A Traditional Chinese translation is now also available in the game.

[b]Changelog[/b]
- Add Lovense integration
- Add Traditional Chinese translation
- Update translations

notes.title: Tales From The Unending Void: Season 1: Bugfix (v0.12.8)
notes.content:
This was going to be a much more upbeat update post, but the recent storm raging through the adult gaming world here on Steam and elsewhere has struck a rather sour note. This update contains some change to comply with Steam's recently updated content guidelines. I haven't made these changes lightly and I'd rather not make them, but I don't think it can be prevented at this point.

Other than that this update adds a log of the choices you've made in the game, as well as episode summaries. Another thing I'm very happy about is the Simplified Chinese translation and French translation (the latter courtesy of Rory-Mercury91).

notes.title: Tales From The Unending Void: Season 1: v0.12.6 (Bugfix)
notes.content:
The game now runs on the latest version of the engine, which should hopefully fix the troubles with Steam Deck some users have been reporting. Some render and continuity fixes in this bugfix, it's now also possible to view the extra scenes in the gallery by character instead of per episode.

The game is now also available for macOS, but please not that the builds are not notarized, so GateKeeper will probably complain when running the game for the first time.

Thanks a lot to Nebula for providing an improved version of the Italian translation.

notes.title: Tales From The Unending Void: Season 1: v0.12.4 (Bugfix)
notes.content:
This release fixes the Steam achievements, which were broken in v0.12.3. Completed achievements should trigger retroactively when starting the game (based on my limited testing).

If achievements still don't trigger after the update to v0.12.4, you should [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0C48-FCBD-DA71-93EB]verify the integrity of the game cache[/url]. as it seems that the Steam client doesn't always overwrite the necessary files for the fix to work.

notes.title: Tales From The Unending Void: Season 1: v0.12.2 (Quickfix)
notes.content:
This quickfix should fix a missing variable error that occurred for some players near the end of the game.

Beware though that saves right before the error will still be affected by the bug. To remedy this you can do the following:

- Load save right before the error
- Open the developer console by pressing Shift+O
- Type the following and press enter: [code]$ ep005_taera_body=False[/code]

[b]Changelog[/b]
- Fix missing variable (thanks to MatthewAMEL)

notes.title: Tales From The Unending Void: Season One will be released on May 2
notes.content:
A few weeks ago, I submitted [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858500/Tales_From_The_Unending_Void_Season_1/]Tales From The Unending Void[/url] for review her on Steam. Now, everything is ready for the official release on May 2. I'd be honored if you spread the word and put the game on your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858500/Tales_From_The_Unending_Void_Season_1

Tales From The Unending Void is my next project after Sisterly Lust. While it shares many of the mechanics and kinks found in Sisterly Lust, my new game is set far into the future. 

[h2]Story[/h2]
Camran is a young minor noble from the Sovereignty, a part of space dominated by humans. Erstwhile cadet of the Terran Naval Academy, Cam has been forced by circumstances to travel the galaxy, together with a band of friends, taking on menial jobs and occasionally smuggling some illicit cargo. As he involuntarily becomes part of sinister plans machinated by powerful intrigants, Camran’s life is changed forever…

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Season One contains Episode 1 through 12 with two remaining seasons to be released as DLC
[*] Over 5000 renders
[*] Over 250 animations enhancing the many erotic scenes in the game
[*] Hours of branching story, offering replayability
[*] Rich and atmospheric soundtrack
[*] Scene replay for all sex scenes
[*] Codex detailing the various characters, species, planets and places in the game
[*] 60 achievements
[*] Official English Game guide (press the "Bonus" button in the game's main menu)
[*] Bonus artwork featuring the many women in the game (press the "Bonus" button in the game's main menu)
[/list]
